name: krisgfx9/Wireless-Device-Battery-Monitor
title: krisgfx9/Wireless-Device-Battery-Monitor
summary: Show the battery level of wireless mice, headsets, keyboards and controllers on the Windows 10/11 taskbar. Lightweight tray app, no vendor software needed. Supports Logitech, Razer, SteelSeries, Corsair, HyperX, Glorious, PS4/PS5 DualSense, Xbox and Bluetooth devices.
